## Study 2 -- five strategies, 153 instruments, 8 markets, two freezes (pre-registered)

| Component | Market-level tests | delta Sharpe > 0 | Median delta Sharpe | Sig. gains | Sig. losses | Sign agreement across freezes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rule ADX gate | 80 | 46.2% | -0.01 | 0 | 1 | 60.0% |
| ML regime filter | 75 | 45.3% | -0.01 | 0 | 0 | 51.4% |
| ML meta-labeling | 74 | 67.6% | +0.12 | 1 | 0 | 74.3% |
| ML position sizing | 75 | 70.7% | +0.05 | 0 | 0 | 54.3% |
| ML entry | 75 | 40.0% | -0.15 | 0 | 8 | 74.3% |
| ML exit | 75 | 48.0% | -0.03 | 6 | 1 | 74.3% |
| Meta-label + sizing | 74 | 67.6% | +0.12 | 1 | 0 | 74.3% |

* Significance = Benjamini-Hochberg q < 0.05 on a paired circular-block bootstrap of delta Sharpe.
  Across all 528 market-level tests: 99 raw p < 0.05, 8 significant
  gains, 10 significant losses.
* ML exit is strategy-dependent: median -0.15 for the four trend-followers, +0.70
  for RSI(2) mean reversion (6 significant gains). ML entry: 7 of its
  8 significant losses are RSI(2).
* Cross-market transfer (models fit on every other market): meta-labeling median +0.16,
  meta-label + sizing +0.15.
* Execution realism: stop-level fills (the Study 1 convention) inflate the control's Sharpe by
  +0.34 to +0.77 (10/10 significant).
* In-sample vs out-of-sample mean trade return of the controls (bps): JMA 186 -> 45,
  dual SMA 330 -> -14, Donchian 80 -> 4,
  TS momentum 240 -> -13, RSI(2) 14 -> -44.

Full tables: `results/study2/analysis/` and the paper (`paper/MBCA_paper.pdf`).
